title: KAITO — A Cheshire Smile〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yay, they're here! Heeey♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hi, Miku! Wonderhoy☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Argh! Pipe down, will you?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I also feel relieved since we hadn't seen any of you since Project Wonder ended.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Our show had a bigger impact than we expected, so we've been quite busy with our usual performances among other things.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Not only that, we were chosen to become ambassadors for Phoenix Wonderland!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We're about to become much, much busier than before!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ambassadors? Congratulations!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: However, we still don't actually know what we'll be doing...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey, Miku, I don't see the plushies, Rin or anyone else. Where are they all?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Today's our day off and we don't have practice today♪ They might be off playing somewhere together...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, okay!
Let's go find them later, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, okay...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Since the show was a success, I guess there's no reason to worry anymore but, is Phoenix Wonderland all good now?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. It looks like the partnership deal is off the table and Emu's brothers are reviewing the management policy.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It seems that Emu's feelings have finally reached her family.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It sure did. Plus, it was also a show filled to the brim with the thoughts and feelings of the entire Phoenix Wonderland cast. There was no way that it wouldn't move them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I did all that because I wanted to cheer up Saki...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Like that show we saw together, the one that made me want to become a star...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: On a subconscious level, I must have been so afraid that Tsukasa would start hating me and leave, like everyone else did...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Somewhere along the way, I started to press the brakes out of not wanting to lose what took me so long to find...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm sorry for making you worry. I'm fine now. I've been practicing since morning and am ready for anything.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And now, I can sing like I used to... From my heart.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I want Phoenix Wonderland to be a place that makes everyone smile forever and ever!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I don't care if you replace all the rides and get rid of the stages...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I just don't want it to stop being a place where everyone can smile, laugh and be happy!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm sure that as long as we try to do that, we'll get more and more guests to come and visit... Please...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (They've all been through so much...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (And even so, they never forgot their desire to make everyone smile with their shows)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you, everyone...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh! You seem happy, KAITO♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
That's so great!
It means your smile came back full circle☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, it really did!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? His smile? Full circle?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. It's about something I told Miku earlier.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: By being in a show, your smile can make your friends and so many others smile. Those smiles can even boomerang back to put one on your face!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: My goal is to make it so this troupe can do just that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. Thus coming back full circle.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Exactly. That circle of smiles included me as well, and they all came right back to cheer me up.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The circle you created, Emu, brought in Tsukasa, Rui, Nene and so many others...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Your shows have all touched the hearts of countless people, and that joy returned to find a home in your heart, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
You really are quite something.
Your circle's come to include so many smiles.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. That's because everyone was there to help me!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I see. That means...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As ambassadors, we must expand this circle so that it will encompass this world! No, this universe...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Universe might be going too far...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It'd be great to have some space aliens see our shows♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Instead of having a space-themed show, we could have a show literally in space. Imagine the possibilities...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, yeah.
You don't need to keep egging them on either, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. Hahaha.
